name: Vertavillo (Spain)
description: A hoist third of white with stripes of red, purple, blue and yellow along its upper and lower edges bearing a red cross of Saint James, the fly purple charged with the crowned municipal arms of Vertavillo (a castle on red and a sheaf and vine on white).
history: Vertavillo adopted its arms and flag officially on 23 May 2014, published in the Boletín Oficial de Castilla y León on 6 June 2014; the flag is of dimensions 2:3, tierced at the hoist.

features.role: narrow stripes along the upper edge of the hoist third
Vertavillo arms — castle on red, sheaf and vine on white
